On [-1,1], f is a polynomial so it is twice differentiable everywhere. Computing the second derivative gives
f''(x)=x^8-(26/25)x^6+(241/625)x^4-(936/15625)x^2+4917791/1600000000.
At x=0, f''(0)=4917791/1600000000>0, while at x^2=2/5 (i.e. x=±sqrt(2/5)∈[-1,1]) one gets
f''(±sqrt(2/5))=4917791/1600000000-252/78125= -243169/1600000000<0.
Thus f'' changes sign on [-1,1], so f is neither convex nor concave on this interval.
